questions.question: What does a face shield do?

options.text: Does not protect as well as goggles.

questions.explanation: A plastic face shield gives the best protection for your eyes and face. Regular glasses are not enough. In Vermont, you do not need eye or face protection if your motorcycle has a windshield, but it is still a good idea.

questions.question: What is one benefit of doing regular maintenance on your motorcycle?

options.text: Your motorcycle will run well for a long time.
Maintenance takes a lot of time.
Maintenance checks can help prevent parking tickets.

questions.correctAnswerText: Your motorcycle will run well for a long time.
questions.explanation: Your motorcycle will stay in good condition if you maintain it properly and do routine checks regularly.

questions.question: What is the main active ingredient in marijuana?
questions.explanation: THC is the main active ingredient in marijuana. The full name is tetrahydrocannabinol.

questions.question: What should you do if you feel tired while riding?

options.text: Keep riding and hope you wake up.

questions.explanation: Do not ride when you are tired. On long trips, take a break at least every two hours to prevent fatigue.

questions.question: How can you make riding at night safer?

options.text: It is not safe to ride at night.
Night riding is not safe because other drivers cannot see your turn signals.
Only ride at night in the city.

questions.explanation: Wear reflective clothing when riding at night. This makes other drivers able to see you better.

questions.question: What should you do when riding on a slippery surface?
questions.explanation: On slippery surfaces, reduce your speed. Use both brakes when stopping and avoid sudden movements.

questions.question: Unlike food and drinks, alcohol does not need to be digested. What does this mean?

options.text: Alcohol reaches your brain within minutes and starts to affect you.
Alcohol stays in your body forever.
It takes a long time to feel alcohol's effects.
Your body gets rid of alcohol very quickly.

questions.correctAnswerText: Alcohol reaches your brain within minutes and starts to affect you.
questions.explanation: Alcohol enters your bloodstream quickly and reaches your brain within minutes because it does not need to be digested. Your body removes about one drink per hour.

questions.question: What do you need to carry a passenger on your motorcycle?

options.text: Extra foot pegs for the passenger.
A seat that fits two people.
Protective gear for you and your passenger.

questions.explanation: To safely carry a passenger, you need a seat for two people, foot pegs for the passenger, and protective gear for both of you.

questions.question: What should you do before riding an unfamiliar motorcycle?

options.text: Ride it like your own bike since all bikes are the same.
Check the controls and gear pattern.
Trust the owner that everything works.
Assume you know where all controls are.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check the controls and gear pattern.
questions.explanation: All motorcycles are different. Check the controls and learn the gear pattern before riding. Practice the throttle, clutch, and brakes first.

questions.question: How can you help others see you as a motorcycle rider?
questions.explanation: To be more visible, wear bright clothing, keep your headlight on at all times, and use your turn signals.

questions.question: How can a motorcycle rider improve their visibility?
questions.explanation: Wear bright-colored clothing with reflective materials. Keep your headlight on at all times. Use your signals and brake light correctly. This helps other drivers see you.

questions.question: What does a plastic, shatter-resistant face shield do?

options.text: It is not needed if you have a windshield.
It does not work as well as goggles.

questions.explanation: A plastic, shatter-resistant face shield protects your whole face during a crash. Goggles protect only your eyes. A windshield alone is not enough protection.

questions.question: Before riding a motorcycle, you should check all of these except:
questions.explanation: Before riding, check the tire tread and air pressure, oil and fluid levels, lights, and signals. You do not need to check for paint damage.

questions.question: Which sign is yellow with black lettering or symbols?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black lettering or symbols. They alert drivers about upcoming road conditions.

questions.question: On which surface does a motorcycle have the best traction?
questions.explanation: Dry pavement provides the best traction. Wet pavement, gravel, sand, mud, snow, ice, painted lines, and metal plates are all hazardous for motorcycles.

questions.question: What should you look for in a helmet to get the best protection?

options.text: It meets Department of Transportation standards.

questions.correctAnswerText: It meets Department of Transportation standards.
questions.explanation: Choose a helmet that meets U.S. Department of Transportation (DOT) and state safety standards. It should fit snugly and have no visible defects.

questions.question: The body eliminates about one drink per hour. If someone had eight drinks four hours ago, how many drinks are likely still in their body?
questions.explanation: Subtract the number of hours passed from the number of drinks consumed. Eight drinks minus four hours equals four drinks remaining in the system.

questions.question: If you wait one hour after having one drink before riding:

options.text: You cannot be arrested for drunk riding.
Your riding skills will not be affected.
The alcohol may still affect you.
You will be fine as long as you ride slowly.

questions.correctAnswerText: The alcohol may still affect you.
questions.explanation: The body eliminates about one drink per hour. However, alcohol can still build up in your system and affect your ability to ride safely.

questions.question: If another driver is tailgating you, what should you do?

options.text: Change lanes and let them pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: Change lanes and let them pass.
questions.explanation: The best way to handle a tailgater is to get them in front of you. Change lanes safely and let them pass. Speeding up may only make them tailgate faster.

questions.question: When braking on a motorcycle, which brake should you use?

options.text: Either one, but never both at the same time.

questions.explanation: Always use both brakes at the same time to stop. Using both brakes together is the most effective way to brake.

questions.question: Which one is NOT a slippery surface?

options.text: A strip of oil in the center of a lane

questions.explanation: Many surfaces make it hard for tires to grip the road. Wet pavement, loose gravel or sand, mud, snow, ice, painted lane markings, oil, and metal covers are all hazardous for motorcyclists. Dry pavement is not slippery.

questions.question: A plastic, shatter-resistant face shield protects the wearer from:
questions.explanation: A face shield protects your face from injury in a crash. It also protects you from wind, dust, dirt, rain, insects, and pebbles thrown up by other vehicles.

questions.question: Switching to a lower gear is also called:
questions.explanation: Shifting to a lower gear slows your motorcycle, similar to using the brakes. This is why downshifting is called engine braking.

questions.question: Which one is NOT protective clothing for a motorcyclist?
questions.explanation: Wear protective clothing when riding. This includes sturdy pants and jackets that cover your arms and legs completely, boots or heavy shoes that cover your ankles, and sturdy gloves.

questions.question: A simple way to make your motorcycle easier to see is to:

options.text: Ride with a large flag attached to its frame.
Ride with the headlight turned on.
Ride on the shoulder whenever possible.

questions.correctAnswerText: Ride with the headlight turned on.
questions.explanation: Make yourself easier to see by wearing bright, reflective clothing. Keep your headlight on at all times and use your turn signals and brake light properly.
